description: OLE-ACT: on an ADODB.Connection record loaded modules before creation, after creation, after Provider = ACE, after Open, after a second Open of the same file, and after Close/Release; read Version, Provider, State and the named identity properties (Provider Name/Version/Friendly Name, OLE DB Version, DBMS Name/Version, Active Sessions, Data Source, Initial Catalog, Jet OLEDB:Engine Type, Locale Identifier, Mode, OLE DB Services, Prompt, Extended Properties, User ID, Window Handle) before and after Open, then the whole Properties inventory. Asks the provider module, version, session count and effective initialization values.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
